summary: Backend testing for iteration 3 new features (admin login, toggle-pro, AI daily limit for free users / Pro bypass, notifications, public news, admin news/polls/stats/featured, WebSocket live). Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py with 21 pytest cases. Result: 19/21 PASSED. The 2 failures are both on the WebSocket endpoint /ws/live/{match_id} when reached via the public preview URL (ingress returns HTTP 502). Direct connection to backend on localhost:8001 works correctly (verified ball-by-ball JSON messages stream every ~2s with score/last_ball), so the WS endpoint logic is sound; the issue is that the Kubernetes ingress only routes /api/* to the backend - /ws/* is not routed to port 8001. Previous iteration 2 suite (43/43) remains unaffected.

critical.issue: External/public URL returns HTTP 502 on WebSocket upgrade (wss://<preview>/ws/live/m_live_1). Works on ws://localhost:8001/ws/live/m_live_1 (verified streaming). Root cause: ingress only proxies /api/* to backend; /ws/* is directed to Expo (3000) which cannot handle it. Fix: register the websocket route under /api (e.g. @app.websocket('/api/ws/live/{match_id}')) and update frontend WS URL accordingly. Also need to confirm ingress performs WebSocket upgrade on /api paths.

minor.issue: Endpoint is unauthenticated-togglable locally (any logged-in user can self-upgrade to Pro). This is by design per user request (payments skipped) but should be flagged before production.
Demo-seed-on-empty pattern: inserting seeds on first GET mutates state and can cause race conditions under concurrent first requests. Low risk in demo.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend connects to wss://<EXPO_BACKEND_URL>/ws/live/{id}; since ingress rejects with 502, the app will never receive streamed ball updates in preview env. Backend itself is correct.

action_items: Register WebSocket route under the /api prefix: change `@app.websocket('/ws/live/{match_id}')` to `@app.websocket('/api/ws/live/{match_id}')` so the Kubernetes ingress routes it to backend:8001. Update the frontend client in /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx to connect to `${EXPO_BACKEND_URL.replace('http','ws')}/api/ws/live/${id}`.
After the move, re-run iteration3 WS tests (2 cases) to confirm streaming over public URL.
(Optional/cleanup) Guard the seed-on-empty logic in /api/news and /api/notifications with an idempotent upsert or startup seeder to avoid duplicate demo rows under concurrent first hits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 40 `os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'] = EMERGENT_LLM_KEY` is a misleading fallback placeholder that could mask misconfiguration; either remove or document.

server.py WS loop sleeps 2s per ball. A completed T20 innings (120 balls) can keep a socket open for ~4 minutes; no idle client ping or max-duration guard. Consider adding a simple `if not ws.client_state.CONNECTED` check or heartbeat.
Admin seed uses `@app.on_event('startup')` which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
`toggle_pro` has no audit log / rate limit - anyone logged in can flip their own flag (by design per user request, but flag for prod).

rca_of_issue: WebSocket 502 over public URL → RCA: FastAPI registers the route on `app` (not on api_router with the /api prefix), so the final path is /ws/live/{match_id}. The preview-env Kubernetes ingress forwards ONLY /api/* to backend:8001; all other paths go to Expo:3000. Expo's Metro dev server has no /ws/live handler, hence HTTP 502 on the upgrade. Reproduction: `python3 -c "import asyncio,websockets; asyncio.run(websockets.connect('wss://runs-analytics.preview.emergentagent.com/ws/live/m_live_1').__aenter__())"` -> InvalidStatus HTTP 502. Control: `ws://localhost:8001/ws/live/m_live_1` streams JSON messages successfully every 2s. Mitigation: move endpoint to /api/ws/live/{match_id} and update the frontend URL builder in match/[id].tsx.
